task.description: Second rework of docs/design/REQ-069-tenant-look-format.md after the design gate pass 2 FAIL (step 04; the next pass is the LAST: a third FAIL stops the run for the owner, decisions/0079 item 4). Read step 04's result completely (G1-G11 with fixes) and decisions/0085 (items 1-8). Correction of ORCH's earlier task text: the progress look is a field of the data of REQ-065 and is drawn by REQ-066, not REQ-064 (REQ-064 is the stage storage): fix G3 everywhere. Fix ALL findings: G1 MU54 (restate as the killable breakage "ctx.line returns false after a success so the charset step never runs", bound to LK-2f, or move to the equivalent mutants with the reason; state in D10/D15 whether the return value of ctx.line is kept and for what); G2 MU55 (add a test or an LP-1 variant for a /3 file whose `questions` is not a list and for a list with non-object entries: usual lines, no exception, code 1; keep MU55 bound to it; cover sections 4.2 and 5.6); G3; G4 (header, section 0 item 8, 16.1, 16.2, 16.4, Q12, MU64: restate as answered by decisions/0085 item 8 and say items 1-8); G5 (3.32); G6 (name the real killing cases of MU23, fix case (3), bind MU34 to LK-4f); G7 (the E_TEXT text for a lone half of a pair in the catalogue and in LK-2e: take it from the real code and measure the word count); G8 (name the test or tests that run all 87 sample rows against the literal lines of the helper); G9 (add to 13.4 that the new picker-look* files must not contain the words of a turned-off rule or an ignored formatter even in strings or comments, AP-077); G10 (split sub-step 69d by criteria groups with the expected red sets of each part, keep the order consistent); G11 (name ownLookOfView in the unchecked-file row). Before reporting do a hard validator-style pass yourself: apply on a scratch COPY outside the project (never git checkout/reset/stash/clean, also not in copies) a model of at least 20 of the named mutants of the pure rules against the tests exactly as the design states them and confirm each is killed by the named test (the validator did exactly this and found MU54 and MU55 unkillable: look for any other mutant whose named test cannot see it, especially those bound by reading); re-read every criterion of the current REQ-069 block against the table; check the numbers (counts of tests, files, words) by running the commands that can run now; check no section contradicts another and that all references to decisions/0085 say items 1-8. Edit only the design file and your handoff. No code. No machine paths or project names in the handoff text (say "the traces list"). Close the handoff with the finding→action table and the list of mutants you checked.

result.summary: Second rework of the design of REQ-069 after the FAIL of gate pass 2 (two Medium G1, G2; nine Low G3-G11). All 11 findings are taken, none refused; one extra correction found by my own pass (H1, the chips range ends) is named openly. The unkillable mutants of the gate are fixed: MU54 is restated as the killable breakage and its opposite moved to the equivalent mutants (D10 and D15 now say the return value of ctx.line is kept and what it is for); MU55 now has a test (new LK-5e, plus enumerated LP-1 variants for questions). New tests: LK-1e (all 89 sample files against the literal lines of the helper) and LK-5e. Message M37 (lone half of a pair, 8 words, measured from the real code) joins the catalogue. REQ-064 is replaced by REQ-065 and REQ-066; every reference to decisions/0085 says items 1-8 and O5 is answered. Sub-step 69d is split into 69d1 and 69d2 with measured red sets. Hard validator-style pass: a model of the named tests (written as section 11.2 states them, with independent oracles) was run against 75 mutant variants of the sketch code on a scratch copy: 73 killable ones are red in the test named in their row, the 2 equivalent ones stay green, and the old MU54 form was confirmed unkillable; MU65 was run as 11 message-text variants against the sample table (all red). Every criterion of the current REQ-069 block was re-read against the table of 11.1; counts were re-measured where they can run now. The design file is 848 lines (was 836); no code, no code fences.
